name: Suprsend
description: SuprSend is a notification infrastructure platform that enables businesses and developers to create, manage, and deliver multi-channel notifications from a single API. It supports email, SMS, push, in-app, and chat notifications with advanced workflows, user preferences, and provider-agnostic integrations to ensure reliable and scalable communication
